messages.content:
Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates an emulation environment using the seedemu library. The environment should include multiple layers such as Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, and WebService. It should create several Internet Exchanges with custom display names. It should also create Transit Autonomous Systems and single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services. The code should also add a host with a customized IP address to one of the Autonomous Systems and create a real-world Autonomous System. It should enable remote access to one of the Autonomous System's network. The code should also set up peering via a route server and private peering with different peer relationships. Finally, the code should add all the layers to the emulator, save the emulator to a component file, and render and compile the emulator.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
shouldMerge, createAutonomousSystem, AutonomousSystem, PoAServer, makeEmulatorBaseWith5StubASAndHosts, makeEmulatorBaseWith10StubASAndHosts, setAutonomousSystem, getAutonomousSystem, __configureAutonomousSystem, ScionAutonomousSystem, doesAContainB, makeStubAsWithHosts, getNodeByAsnAndName, addPrivatePeering, up_emulator, to_json, toGraphviz, resolveTo, get_balance_with_name, createEmulation

message.content:
```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, WebService
from seedemu.layers import InternetExchange, Host, AutonomousSystem, ServiceType
from seedemu.services import WebServer
from seedemu.core import IpAddress

# Create the emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
base = Base()
routing = Routing()
ebgp = Ebgp()
ibgp = Ibgp()
ospf = Ospf()
web = WebService()

# Create Internet Exchanges with custom display names
ix1 = InternetExchange(100, displayName="IX Alpha")
ix2 = InternetExchange(200, displayName="IX Beta")
ix3 = InternetExchange(300, displayName="IX Gamma")
base.addInternetExchange(ix1)
base.addInternetExchange(ix2)
base.addInternetExchange(ix3)

# Create Transit Autonomous Systems
as1 = AutonomousSystem(1, "Transit AS1")
as2 = AutonomousSystem(2, "Transit AS2")
as3 = AutonomousSystem(3, "Transit AS3")
base.addAutonomousSystem(as1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(as2)
base.addAutonomousSystem(as3)

# Create single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services
as10 = AutonomousSystem(10, "Stub AS10")
as11 = AutonomousSystem(11, "Stub AS11")
as12 = AutonomousSystem(12, "Stub AS12")
base.addAutonomousSystem(as10)
base.addAutonomousSystem(as11)
base.addAutonomousSystem(as12)

# Add hosts to stub ASes
host10 = Host("host10")
host11 = Host("host11")
host12 = Host("host12")
as10.addHost(host10)
as11.addHost(host11)
as12.addHost(host12)

# Add web services to stub ASes
web.addWebService(10, "host10")
web.addWebService(11, "host11")
web.addWebService(12, "host12")

# Add a host with a customized IP address to AS10
custom_host = Host("customhost")
custom_host.setIpAddress(IpAddress("10.10.10.42"))
as10.addHost(custom_host)

# Create a real-world Autonomous System (e.g., Google AS15169)
real_as = AutonomousSystem(15169, "Google")
base.addAutonomousSystem(real_as)

# Connect ASes to Internet Exchanges
ix1.addParticipant(1)
ix1.addParticipant(2)
ix1.addParticipant(10)
ix2.addParticipant(2)
ix2.addParticipant(3)
ix2.addParticipant(11)
ix3.addParticipant(3)
ix3.addParticipant(12)
ix3.addParticipant(15169)

# Enable remote access to AS10's network
base.enableRemoteAccess(10)

# Set up peering via a route server at IX1
ebgp.addRouteServer(100, [1, 2, 10])

# Set up private peering with different peer relationships
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(1, 2, 100, relationship="peer")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(2, 3, 200, relationship="transit")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(3, 15169, 300, relationship="peer")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(1, 10, 100, relationship="customer")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(2, 11, 200, relationship="customer")
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(3, 12, 300, relationship="customer")

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(base)
emu.addLayer(routing)
emu.addLayer(ebgp)
emu.addLayer(ibgp)
emu.addLayer(ospf)
emu.addLayer(web)

# Save the emulator to a component file
emu.save("emulation-component.bin")

# Render and compile the emulator
emu.render()
emu.compile()
```
